title: Meridian industry config
description: Re-skins a Meridian deployment for a target industry. This is the full authored `industry:` block from a `values-<industry>.yaml` overlay — broader than what reaches the browser. `company`/`theme`/`terminology`/`screens`/`home`/`entities` are rendered to /config.json by helm/templates/industry-configmap.yaml and merged over each SPA's baked defaults (frontends/<app>/src/config/defaults.js) at startup; `data`/`routing`/`dynatrace` are backend-only (omitted from that render, consumed via env by traffic-bot/service-dispatch/the Dynatrace provisioner). Whatever IS rendered to the browser must never include secrets. Root additionalProperties stays open for forward compatibility.

name.description: Full brand name shown in the UI (e.g. 'Meridian City').

short.description: Short brand name (e.g. 'Meridian'), used where space is tight.

persona.description: One-line persona used in the assistant system prompt.

colors.description: Brand palette as hex; mapped to CSS variables (--brand, --accent, …) at runtime.

logo.description: URL or path to the brand logo.

favicon.description: URL or path to the favicon.

heroImage.description: URL to a background photo shown behind the brand gradient in the WelcomeHero card.

terminology.description: Maps generic domain nouns (customer, request, incident, asset, workOrder, …) to industry-specific nouns.

requestCategories.description: Dropdown options for the Submit a request form. Always end with 'other'.

iotZoneLabels.description: Maps raw zone IDs (e.g. 'zone-north') to industry-appropriate display labels.

iotAnomalyLabels.description: Maps raw anomaly_type values (e.g. 'engine_overtemp') to industry-appropriate display labels.

iotZonePositions.description: Maps zone IDs to {x,y} cluster centers on the status-map viewBox for auto-clustering IoT devices.

screens.description: Which curated screen modules (or generic entity-template pages) each SPA mounts.

home.description: Home-page module composition per SPA (module ids from the home-module registry, or generic entity-template cards).

entities.description: Config-driven entity/lifecycle definitions — the generic entity engine. Each key is an entity type id (e.g. 'flight', 'service_request'). Rendered to the browser in full alongside company/theme/screens/home: entity definitions contain no secrets, and the frontend's generic list/detail/map/analytics templates need the browser-relevant parts (states, fields, computed.position) at render time, so it isn't worth building per-field projection logic to strip out the backend-only mechanics (transition conditions/effects, generator strategy) that the frontend simply ignores.

data.description: Backend-only demo data seeds, delivered to traffic-bot via the INDUSTRY_DATA env var. Never rendered to the browser.

routing.description: Backend-only category→department map, delivered to service-dispatch's RoutingEngine via the ROUTING_MAP env var. Keys must match data.requestTemplates[].category. Never rendered to the browser.

dynatrace.description: Backend-only Dynatrace naming + Business Flow config, consumed by the per-instance provisioner (helm/files/provision-dynatrace-business-config.py). Never rendered to the browser.

serviceNames.description: k8s deployment name → Dynatrace service display name (builtin:naming.services).

flowLabels.description: Business-flow key → Business Flow title override.

flows.description: Which business-flow keys to actually provision for this industry.

oneOf.description: A home widget or ticker module — id must be unique within this list. No entityType required.

height.description: ticker height: slim = marquee bar (~40px), half = compact card, full = expanded card listing all items.

label.description: ticker slim mode: prefix badge text shown before the scrolling content (e.g. '📡 LIVE' or '✈️ DEPARTURES').

title.description: ticker half/full mode: card header. Also used by announcements.

preset.description: ticker only: generates plausible placeholder items when items is empty. Prefer providing explicit items.

items.description: ticker: array of strings to display. announcements: array of {title, body, tone?} objects. LLM should write industry-relevant content from research.

timezones.description: clock-widget only: [{tz, label}] — tz='local' uses device time.

entityType.description: entity-summary-card / entity-kpi-row: entity type key from top-level entities map.

oneOf.description: A generic entity-template page or card — id must be unique within this list, entityType must be a key in the top-level entities map.

labelField.description: entity-map: which field to show next to each sprite.

steps.description: entity-journey only: ordered list of steps to show. Each item is either a state key string or an object with `state` (key) and `label` (display text) — use object form to override the state's default label.

ownerField.description: entity-journey only (portal): entity field whose value matches the logged-in user's id. When set, shows the personal journey view for authenticated users.

description.description: entity-journey: subtitle shown below the page heading.

oneOf.description: A status-map page: static per-location coordinates with real-time status coloring. entityType optional when source=devices.

entityType.description: Entity type to fetch status from. Omit when source='devices'.

source.description: 'devices' fetches from the IoT devices API. Omit for entity engine.

clusterBy.description: 'zone' auto-spreads devices around iotZonePositions cluster centers (uses IoT devices API).

locations.description: Explicit per-item positions (seating chart, parking lot). Each entry is { id, x, y, label? }.

statusColors.description: Overrides the default ok/warning/alert/available/occupied color map.

labelField.description: Which field to show next to each dot.

fields.description: Keys must be the real snake_case wire field name (e.g. 'flight_number'), matching the API's JSON casing — an authoring LLM must not camelCase these.

entity.description: ref type only: must be a key in the top-level entities map.

initial.description: Must be a key in states.

states.description: At least one state should be terminal:true.

kpiField.description: When isKpi:true, the numeric field whose value to sum/avg for the KPI metric (e.g. 'amount_cents'). Used by the Dynatrace provisioner's derive_flow_specs_from_entity_config().

externallyTriggered.description: Set true on states that are only reachable via a cross-entity callService effect (e.g. incident.resolved triggered by work_order completion). The validator skips local-transition reachability for these states.

glyph.description: Emoji/unicode sprite glyph for this state, used by the entity-map template.

transitions.description: Evaluated in declared order per 'from' state; first match wins. from/to must be keys in states.

when.description: {field,equals|notEquals} | {probability} | {faultGate,probability} | {link,field,equals}. Loosely typed here — semantic validity isn't ajv-checked.

linkOnCreate.description: Best-effort link to another entity at creation time, e.g. a passenger picking a departing flight.

position.description: Backend-computed (movement-service) scene position for the entity-map template.

waypoints.description: state → {x,y}. Keys must be a subset of this entity's states. AUTHORING GOTCHA: always quote the "y" key in YAML (e.g. helm/values-*.yaml) -- unquoted, YAML 1.1 reads the bareword key `y` as the boolean `true` (the classic Norway-problem coercion, also affects Yes/No/On/Off), which then silently serializes as the JSON key "true" instead of "y".

generator.description: Backend-only generation config. additionalProperties is open because periodicHistoryBackfill carries strategy-specific fields (ownerEntityType, backfill, amount, etc.) that vary per strategy and are consumed only by the entity engine.

fields.description: Per-field generation hints, e.g. { has_bag: { probability: 0.6 } }.

triggers.description: Backend-only Kafka trigger config: maps topic names to trigger behaviour for this entity type.
